title: Karoryfer Black And Green Guitars v1.000, green Gretsch Anniversary, keyswitch program

approximations.pm: no palm-mute samples; staccato samples stand in
approximations.dead: no dead-note samples; staccato samples stand in
approximations.pull: no pull-off samples; hammer-on samples stand in
approximations.slide: no slide samples; hammer-on samples stand in for the arrival note, no audible glide
approximations.tap: no tap samples; ordinary pick attack

di_advance_note: measured in the green-guitar smoke test: the steepest attack rise is 21-22 ms after the MIDI note-on for every note; sfizz itself adds none (sine test). Assumed the same for the black guitar (same library, not measured separately).
